title: Material quantities map to declared resultants
statement_lean:
theorem material_resultants (E A L G As h s : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hh : 0 < h) :
    axial E A L * s = A * (E * (s / L)) ∧
      shear G As h * s = As * (G * (s / h))

assumptions: Exactly the quantified parameters and explicit hypotheses in the full Lean statement.
limitations: Original finite discrete passive guided model only. No certified differentiation, continuum equilibrium, JavaScript refinement, anatomy or biological calibration. E is a reduced axial modulus; two localized macro-links are an authored discretization.

title: Both end-pull scalars match the effective stiffness

title: Quadratic completion gives the unique discrete minimum
statement_lean:
theorem energy_completion_unique_minimum (K1 K2 CL CR d u v : ℝ)
    (hK1 : 0 < K1) (hK2 : 0 < K2) (hCL : 0 ≤ CL) (hCR : 0 ≤ CR) :
    energy K1 K2 CL CR d u v - effective K1 K2 CL CR * d ^ 2 / 2 =
      (K1 + CR) / 2 * (u - upper K1 CR d) ^ 2 +
        (K2 + CL) / 2 * (v - lower K2 CL d) ^ 2 ∧
    0 ≤ energy K1 K2 CL CR d u v - effective K1 K2 CL CR * d ^ 2 / 2 ∧
    (energy K1 K2 CL CR d u v = effective K1 K2 CL CR * d ^ 2 / 2 ↔
      u = upper K1 CR d ∧ v = lower K2 CL d)

title: Stronger interface increases effective stiffness

    effective K1 K2 CL CR' - effective K1 K2 CL CR =
      K1 ^ 2 * (CR' - CR) / ((K1 + CR') * (K1 + CR)) ∧
